Yomori is independently maintained and does not provide, recommend, preselect, install, or trust content sources. Compatible extensions are separate user-installed software.
Standard Yomori builds contain no ads, analytics, tracking, or telemetry. Source-backed reading may use the network only through explicit user actions and user-selected integrations or extensions.
Yomori is licensed under Apache-2.0 and preserves required Mihon/Tachiyomi upstream attribution and non-affiliation.
